h2: Explore every Portable Office size & its applications
intro: Team sizes shown are layout guidance based on typical workstation plans — your drawing confirms exact capacity.

panels.paragraph: The entry office for single-supervisor sites. Fits a desk, files and a visitor chair without wasting plot area.
applications: same MS platform as every size

panels.paragraph: Built for the site margin nobody else can use: 8 ft width slides along boundary walls and gate lines.
The reference SAMAN office and our most-ordered size; 4–6 workstations or cabin + manager desk.
Two extra feet of width that turn a workstation row into a working office with a meeting corner.
The two-room size: cabin partition + open bay is the standard drawing we issue.
A corridor of workstations for teams that need seats, not span.
Project headquarters: reception, two cabins and an open bay in one delivered unit.
Same 400 sq ft as 40x10 in a square plan — the open-plan choice where the plot allows depth.
The largest standard portable office we build: rooms, stores and pantry under one roof.
